Dave is rough.

Kind($x, True) && Quiet($x, True) >>> Green($x, True) ::: Kind, quiet things are green.
Kind(Dave, True) >>> Quiet(Dave, True) ::: If Dave is kind then Dave is quiet.

Rough($x, True) && Kind($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: All rough, kind things are quiet.

Query:
Rough(Dave, True) ::: Dave is rough.
